section_summary: This section documents State Department and Office of Naval Intelligence oversight of Japanese merchant shipping between June and July 1941, opening with diplomatic friction over U.S. customs seizing naval codes from the whaling ship Nisshin Maru during a narcotics search. It details intelligence surveillance across global ports, including British-instigated stevedoring slowdowns in Chile and Philippine petroleum supply controls. Crucially, the papers record widespread shipping cancellations and official confirmations that Japan was recalling its merchant vessels to home waters in anticipation of major northern and Pacific operations.

subfiles.about: Reports discussions with Commander McCollum regarding the customs search of a Japanese whaling vessel and temporary seizure of a naval code.
subfiles.summary: McCollum and Coville discussed customs seizing a confidential code package during a narcotics search of the Nisshin Maru at Port Costa.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation on seizure of Japanese naval code at Port Costa

subfiles.about: Protests the customs search of the Nisshin Maru at Port Costa and the seizure of naval and government codes.
subfiles.summary: Japanese Embassy protests the forceful seizure and six-hour detention of naval and government codes aboard the Nisshin Maru at Port Costa.
subfiles.title: Aide-mémoire protesting search of Nisshin Maru

subfiles.about: Transmits the Japanese Embassy aide-mémoire regarding the Nisshin Maru search to the Treasury Department for comment.
subfiles.summary: Secretary of State transmits the Japanese Embassy aide-mémoire concerning the Nisshin Maru search to the Treasury Department requesting comments.
subfiles.title: Note to Secretary of the Treasury enclosing aide-mémoire

subfiles.about: Records conversation with Counselor Iguchi regarding the Japanese protest over the search of the Nisshin Maru.
subfiles.summary: Counselor Iguchi presented an aide-mémoire regarding the Nisshin Maru search; Hamilton expressed surprise at naval codes aboard merchant vessels.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation on search of Nisshin Maru

subfiles.about: Cross-references a consular despatch from Brazil reporting narcotics smuggling arrests on the Japanese vessel Nana Maru.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference sheet citing despatch 4835 from Brazil reporting the arrest of French nationals for narcotics on the Nana Maru.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference File Note on narcotics on Nana Maru

subfiles.about: Forwards intercepted teletypes ordering Japanese shipping and personnel to return to Japan by specified deadlines.
subfiles.summary: ONI transmits intercepted teletypes ordering Japanese vessels, officials, and nationals to return to Japan and clear the Panama Canal.
subfiles.title: Memorandum on Japanese shipping activities and repatriation orders

subfiles.about: Reports British naval agents organizing stevedoring slowdowns in Chilean ports to delay mineral-loading Japanese merchant vessels.
subfiles.summary: Reports British agents along South America's west coast instructing stevedores to intentionally slow down mineral loading for Japanese merchant ships.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 146 on British slowdown of Japanese vessel loading

subfiles.about: Reports the movements of the Japanese vessel Naruto Maru at Antofagasta.
subfiles.summary: Reports Naruto Maru arrived at Antofagasta from Caldera July 7 and sailed for Tocopilla July 8; paraphrased to OPNAV.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Antofagasta on Naruto Maru

subfiles.about: Reports the arrival of the Japanese vessel Yamabiko Maru at Vancouver from Seattle.
subfiles.summary: Reports arrival of Japanese vessel Yamabiko Maru at Vancouver from Seattle on July 7; relayed to Navy.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Vancouver on arrival of Yamabiko Maru

subfiles.about: Reports sailings of the Genyo Maru, Nitta Maru, and Asahisan Maru from Japanese ports.
subfiles.summary: Tanker Genyo cleared for Los Angeles, Nitta sailed for Manila, and Asahisan departed for Haiphong, Saigon, and Bangkok.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Yokohama on vessel departures

subfiles.about: Reports movements of the Japanese vessel Gingo Maru through Peruvian ports bound for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Reports Japanese ship Gingo Maru arrived July 8 from Valparaiso and sailed July 9 for Kobe via Chancay.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Lima on movements of Gingo Maru

subfiles.about: Reports the departure of the Japanese vessel Yamabiko Maru from Vancouver for Aberdeen, Washington.
subfiles.summary: Reports departure of Japanese vessel Yamabiko Maru from Vancouver on July 8 destined for Aberdeen, Washington.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Vancouver on departure of Yamabiko Maru

subfiles.about: Reports the Anyo Maru attempting an early departure from Bombay and NYK communications intercepted by British authorities.
subfiles.summary: Anyo Maru sought early departure before discharging full cargo; customs refused clearance, and intercepted messages reveal NYK urgency.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Bombay on Anyo Maru

subfiles.about: Instructs the Consul in Bombay to continue reporting unusual movements of Japanese merchant vessels.
subfiles.summary: Relays Navy Department appreciation for shipping intelligence and instructs consul to continue reporting unusual Japanese vessel movements.
subfiles.title: Telegram to Bombay requesting continued shipping intelligence

subfiles.about: Reports bill of health granted to tanker Akatuki Maru departing Kobe for Los Angeles to load oil.
subfiles.summary: Bill of health granted to tanker Akatuki Maru sailing July 9 from Kobe direct to Los Angeles to load oil.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Kobe on departure of Akatuki Maru

subfiles.about: Reports arrival and departure of Japanese ship Montevideo Maru at Santos.
subfiles.summary: Japanese ship Montevideo Maru arrived Santos July 10 from Rio de Janeiro and sailed July 11 for Montevideo and Buenos Aires.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Santos on movements of Montevideo Maru

subfiles.about: Reports the movements of the Japanese vessel Melbourne Maru at Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: Melbourne Maru arrived Hong Kong July 7 from Moji and departed July 8 for Singapore.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Hong Kong on movements of Melbourne Maru

subfiles.about: Reports bills of health issued at Kobe to the Kasima Maru and Tatsuta Maru, noting lack of further scheduled sailings.
subfiles.summary: Bills of health issued to Kasima Maru and Tatsuta Maru; no further U.S. sailings scheduled until Asama Maru on July 14.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Kobe on merchant sailings

subfiles.about: Reports arrival and departure of Japanese steamship Kurama Maru at Santos.
subfiles.summary: Kurama Maru arrived Santos July 9 from Rio de Janeiro and sailed July 12 for Yokohama via the Panama Canal.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Santos on movements of Kurama Maru

subfiles.about: Reports departure of the Japanese vessel Hakone Maru from Yokohama for Bombay via Singapore.
subfiles.summary: Reports Japanese vessel Hakone Maru sailed July 8 from Yokohama for Bombay via Singapore.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Yokohama on sailing of Hakone Maru

subfiles.about: Reports the arrest of OSK officials in Kobe and shipping cancellations indicating preparations for military activities to the north.
subfiles.summary: Four OSK officials arrested for disclosing cancellation of Toa Maru; shipping cancellations indicate large-scale preparations for northern operations.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Tokyo on arrest of shipping officials and cancellations

subfiles.about: Reports departure of the Japanese vessel Havre Maru from Yokohama for Calcutta.
subfiles.summary: Reports Havre Maru departed July 11 for Calcutta via Hong Kong, Singapore, and Rangoon.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Yokohama on departure of Havre Maru

subfiles.about: Reports arrival and departure of the Japanese ship Norway Maru at Callao.
subfiles.summary: Japanese ship Norway Maru arrived Callao July 11 from Valparaiso and sailed July 12 for Kobe via Los Angeles.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Lima on movements of Norway Maru

subfiles.about: Reports suspension of Japanese shipping to the U.S. East Coast from Dairen and sailings of Nankai Maru and Kamo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Shippers confirm Japanese lines halted shipments to U.S. East Coast; Nankai Maru left for Rangoon and Kamo Maru for Saigon.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Tokyo on shipping suspensions from Dairen

subfiles.about: Reports arrival and departure of the Japanese steamship Africa Maru at Buenos Aires.
subfiles.summary: Japanese steamship Africa Maru departed Buenos Aires July 14 destined for Yokohama via the Panama Canal and Los Angeles.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Buenos Aires on departure of Africa Maru

subfiles.about: Transmits reports from four major oil companies in the Philippines regarding fuel sales to Japanese and French vessels.
subfiles.summary: Transmits duplicate letters from four Philippine oil companies detailing petroleum sales to Japanese and French flag vessels.
subfiles.title: Despatch from Manila enclosing oil company reports

subfiles.about: Reports sales and shipments of bunker fuel, lubricating oil, grease, and surfacing materials during May 1941.
subfiles.summary: Caltex reports bunker fuel sales to American vessels and lubricant shipments to Saigon and Hong Kong; no sales to Japanese vessels.
subfiles.title: Letter from Caltex (Philippines) Inc. on petroleum sales

subfiles.about: Reports bunker fuel deliveries to French vessels and absence of deliveries to Japanese vessels during May 1941.
subfiles.summary: Standard-Vacuum reports no deliveries to Japanese vessels in May, detailing bunker fuel deliveries to three French Messageries Maritimes vessels.
subfiles.title: Letter from Standard-Vacuum Oil Company on bunker deliveries

subfiles.about: Reports refusal of oil supply inquiries from Messageries Maritimes and absence of deliveries to Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Asiatic Petroleum reports no deliveries to French or Japanese vessels in May, having declined Messageries Maritimes inquiries pleading lack of stock.
subfiles.title: Letter from Asiatic Petroleum Company on bunker inquiries

subfiles.about: Reports sales of diesel fuel oil to Japanese fishing operators in the Philippines during May 1941.
subfiles.summary: Tide Water reports sales totaling 36.6 tons of diesel fuel oil to two Japanese fishing consumers in May 1941.
subfiles.title: Letter from Tide Water Associated Oil Company on fuel sales

subfiles.about: Reports arrival of the Japanese vessel Canberra Maru at Sydney from Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Reports Japanese vessel Canberra Maru arrived at Sydney on July 14 from Kobe; teletyped to Navy.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Melbourne on arrival of Canberra Maru

subfiles.about: Reports departures of Tatsuta Maru for San Francisco and Nitiran Maru for the Netherlands East Indies.
subfiles.summary: Reports Tatsuta Maru sailed July 10 for San Francisco and Nitiran Maru reportedly sailed for Surabaya and Batavia.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Yokohama on merchant departures

subfiles.about: Notifies Embassy in Tokyo of global reports indicating Japan is withdrawing its merchant fleet to home waters.
subfiles.summary: Department informs Embassy that widespread reports indicate Japan is withdrawing a substantial part of its merchant fleet to home waters.
subfiles.title: Telegram to Tokyo on withdrawal of merchant fleet

subfiles.about: Reports Japanese Foreign Office explanation for concentrating merchant shipping on shorter Pacific routes.
subfiles.summary: Foreign Office claims vessel recall concentrates shipping on shorter Pacific routes to alleviate regional shortages, though U.S. warrants may be a factor.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Tokyo on official explanation for shipping recall

subfiles.about: Reports scheduled departure of Japanese vessel Belgium Maru from Durban.
subfiles.summary: Reports Japanese flag vessel Belgium Maru scheduled to depart Durban July 15 at 6 p.m.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Lourenco Marques on Belgium Maru

subfiles.about: Reports movements of Japanese vessels Brisbane Maru and Montevideo Maru at Montevideo.
subfiles.summary: Brisbane Maru departed for Buenos Aires July 13; Montevideo Maru departed July 14 for Buenos Aires, Brazilian ports, and Los Angeles.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Montevideo on Japanese vessel movements

subfiles.about: Reports departure of the Anyo Maru from Bombay for Japan via Colombo with cotton cargo.
subfiles.summary: Anyo Maru sailed July 15 for Japan via Colombo after loading 24,000 bales of cotton following NYK agency insistence.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Bombay on departure of Anyo Maru

subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and cargo operations of Japanese vessels Kunikawa Maru and Akagi Maru at Manzanillo.
subfiles.summary: Kunikawa Maru discharging silk and loading cement for Punta Arenas; Akagi Maru discharging general merchandise bound for Valparaiso.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Manzanillo on Kunikawa Maru and Akagi Maru

subfiles.about: Reports departure of the Japanese tanker Dai Iti Ogura Maru from Yokohama for San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: Reports Japanese tanker Dai Iti Ogura Maru sailed July 13 from Yokohama destined for San Francisco.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Yokohama on departure of Dai Iti Ogura Maru

subfiles.about: Reports arrival and departure of the Japanese vessel Kurama Maru at Montevideo.
subfiles.summary: Kurama Maru arrived July 16 from Santos and departed same day for the Canal Zone and Los Angeles.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Montevideo on movements of Kurama Maru

subfiles.about: Reports NYK diversion of the Asama Maru to Batavia to transport German evacuees.
subfiles.summary: ONI reports NYK shifted Asama Maru to Batavia to transport 400 German women and children, delaying return to the Pacific Coast.
subfiles.title: Memorandum on diversion of Asama Maru

subfiles.about: Reports Colombian tug recovering a floating packet with German and Japanese flags near Norway Maru's track.
subfiles.summary: Reports Colombian tug retrieved an unidentified package with a float marked with German and Japanese flags after Norway Maru passed Cape Corrientes.
subfiles.title: Intelligence Report on package picked up by Colombian tug

subfiles.about: Records and indexes incoming G-2 report regarding the float package retrieved by a Colombian tug.
subfiles.from: Military Intelligence Division, Panama Canal Department
subfiles.summary: Document file note indexing incoming G-2 report regarding the float package with German and Japanese flags recovered near Norway Maru.
subfiles.title: Document File Note on package recovered near Norway Maru
